note: Wren Phonics — letter formation data (b410, 2026-10-08). Plain stroke-direction descriptions only (not mnemonic/character content, so SPEC.md's character-originality rule does not apply the same way — these are literal geometry, the same kind of 'generic UK EYFS number-formation language' M02's own header already uses for digits). Family names are Wren's own, not any commercial scheme's. start = [x%, y%] of the glyph box; angle = first-stroke compass direction in degrees (0=right, 90=down, 135=down-left, 180=left), CSS-rotate clockwise — same scheme as M02. exit_stroke follows the DfE Reading Framework handwriting guidance (Note 3, footnote 3): a, d, h, i, k, l, m, n, t, u may carry a simple exit flick once secure; no letter is taught with a lead-in or joining stroke at this stage. provenance: Wren original, b410, 2026-10-08. b421 adds a 3-7 word formation rhyme per lowercase letter (field "rhyme"), describing the actual stroke order of that letter's existing cue — original phrasing, deliberately checked against known commercial-scheme letter-formation phrases (Read Write Inc., Little Wandle, Jolly Phonics, Letters and Sounds, Twinkl) and none reused or closely paraphrased. provenance: Wren original, b421, 2026-10-08.

lowercase.name: Round & Roll
lowercase.description: Start with a curve, like tracing round the edge of a ball.

lowercase.name: Straight Down
lowercase.description: Start with one straight line travelling down.

lowercase.name: Down & Curve
lowercase.description: Start with a straight line down, then a curve or hump.

lowercase.name: Criss-Cross
lowercase.description: Made from diagonal lines that lean or cross.

capitals.name: Round & Roll Capitals
capitals.description: Start with a curve at the top.

capitals.name: Straight Down Capitals
capitals.description: Made from straight up-down and across lines only.

capitals.name: Down & Curve Capitals
capitals.description: A tall straight line down, then a curve.

capitals.name: Criss-Cross Capitals
capitals.description: Made from diagonal lines that lean or cross.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top right of a small round shape. Curve round to the left and all the way back up to where you started, then go straight down without lifting. Finish on the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Round and over, down we go.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of a tall line. Pull straight down, go back up part of the way, then curve round to the right and back. Finish at the bottom of the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Down the twig, loop round the nest.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top right. Curve up, over to the left, round and down. Finish at the bottom right, leaving the c open.
lowercase.rhyme: Curve left around, leave it open.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top right of a small round shape. Curve round to the left and back up to where you started, keep going straight up to make a tall line, then come straight back down it without lifting. Finish on the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Round like c, then tall and down.

lowercase.cue: Start on the left, halfway up the small letters. Go straight across to the right, then curve up, over and round to the left and along the bottom. Finish at the bottom right.
lowercase.rhyme: Straight across, then curl all round.

lowercase.cue: Start a little below the top, on the right. Curve up and over to the left, then pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, then draw a short line across at the top of the small letters, from left to right.
lowercase.rhyme: Curl at the top, down, then cross.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top right of a small round shape. Curve round to the left and back up to where you started, then go straight down below the line and curl round to the left. Finish below the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Round like a, then a long tail.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of a tall line. Pull straight down, go back up part of the way, then over in a hump and down. Finish on the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Down, up and over a hump, down.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of the small letters. Pull straight down and finish on the line. Lift, and add a dot above.
lowercase.rhyme: Short line down, dot on top.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of the small letters. Pull straight down below the line and curl round to the left. Finish below the line. Lift, and add a dot above.
lowercase.rhyme: Straight down, curl under, dot up high.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of a tall line and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top right of the small letters, slant in to touch the tall line, then slant out. Finish on the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Straight down, two legs meet halfway.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of a tall line. Pull straight down. Finish on the line.
lowercase.rhyme: One tall line, top to bottom.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of the small letters. Pull straight down, go back up, over in a hump and down, back up and over in a second hump and down. Finish on the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Down, hump, hump, down again.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of the small letters. Pull straight down, go back up the same line, then over in a hump and down. Finish on the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Down, one hump, then down.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top. Curve round to the left, down, round the bottom and back up. Finish where you started, closing the circle.
lowercase.rhyme: Round the circle, back to the start.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of the small letters. Pull straight down below the line, go back up the same line, then curve round to the right and back. Finish where the curve meets the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Down below, loop round the top.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top right of a small round shape. Curve round to the left and back up to where you started, then pull straight down below the line. Finish below the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Round like a, then straight down below.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of the small letters. Pull straight down, go back up the same line, then curve over to the right. Finish just past the top of the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Down, back up, and flick over.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top right. Curve up and round to the left, then across and back round to the right, and round to the left at the bottom. Finish at the bottom left.
lowercase.rhyme: Curve back, then curve round again.

lowercase.cue: Start a little above the small letters. Pull straight down and finish on the line with a small curve to the right. Lift, then draw a short line across at the top of the small letters, from left to right.
lowercase.rhyme: Tall line down, cross near the top.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top of the small letters. Pull down, curve round the bottom and up to the top, then straight back down. Finish on the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Down, round the bottom, up and down.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top left of the small letters. Slant down to a point on the line, then slant up to the right. Finish at the top right.
lowercase.rhyme: Down to a point, up and out.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top left of the small letters. Slant down to a point, up to the middle, down to a second point, then up. Finish at the top right.
lowercase.rhyme: Two valleys, each one rising up.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top left of the small letters and slant down to the right. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top right and slant down to the left, crossing the first line. Finish on the line.
lowercase.rhyme: One line down, cross it over.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top left of the small letters and slant down to the right, to the line. Lift, start at the top right and slant down to the left, through the first line and on below it. Finish below the line.
lowercase.rhyme: Two lines meet, one dips below.

lowercase.cue: Start at the top left of the small letters. Go straight across to the right, slant down to the bottom left, then straight across to the right. Finish at the bottom right.
lowercase.rhyme: Across, diagonal down, across again.

capitals.cue: Start at the top point. Slant down to the left and finish on the line. Lift, start at the top point again and slant down to the right, finishing on the line. Lift, and draw a short line across the middle, from left to right.

Start at the top and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top again, curve out to the right and back to the middle, then curve out again and back. Finish at the bottom of the line.
Start at the top right. Curve up, over to the left, round and down. Finish at the bottom right, leaving the C open.
Start at the top and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top again and make one big curve out to the right. Finish at the bottom of the line.
Start at the top and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, and draw three lines across from left to right: top, middle, bottom.
Start at the top and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, and draw two lines across from left to right: top, then middle.
Start at the top right. Curve round to the left, down and round the bottom and up to the middle on the right, then go in a little to the left. Finish in the middle.
Start at the top left and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, do the same on the right. Lift, and join them with a line across the middle.
Start at the top and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, and draw short lines across the top and the bottom.
Start at the top right. Pull straight down and curve round to the left at the bottom. Finish at the bottom left.
Start at the top and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top right, slant in to touch the middle of the line, then slant out. Finish on the line.
Start at the top and pull straight down, then go straight across to the right. Finish at the bottom right.
Start at the bottom left. Go straight up, slant down to the middle, slant back up, then straight down. Finish at the bottom right.
Start at the bottom left. Go straight up, slant down to the bottom right, then straight up. Finish at the top right.
Start at the top. Curve round to the left, down, round the bottom and back up. Finish where you started.
Start at the top and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top again, curve out to the right and back to the middle of the line. Finish in the middle.
Start at the top. Curve round to the left, down, round and back up to where you started. Lift, and add a short tail slanting out at the bottom right.
Start at the top and pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top, curve out to the right and back to the middle, then slant down to the right. Finish on the line.
Start at the top right. Curve up and round to the left, then across and round to the right, and round to the left at the bottom. Finish at the bottom left.
Start at the top left and go straight across to the right. Lift, start in the middle of that line and pull straight down. Finish on the line.
Start at the top left. Pull down, curve round the bottom, then go straight up. Finish at the top right.
Start at the top left. Slant down to a point on the line, then slant up to the right. Finish at the top right.
Start at the top left. Slant down to a point, up to the middle, down to a second point, then up. Finish at the top right.
Start at the top left and slant down to the right. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top right and slant down to the left, crossing the first line.
Start at the top left and slant down to the middle. Lift, start at the top right, slant down to the middle, then go straight down. Finish on the line.
Start at the top left. Go straight across to the right, slant down to the bottom left, then straight across to the right. Finish at the bottom right.
